name: 疆域美食 儿子娃娃新疆炒米粉
reviews: Absolutely delicious Xinjiang fried rice noodles! The noodles were chewy, the sauce was rich and flavorful, and the spice level was perfect. Great portion size and excellent service. Highly recommend!
好吃的新疆菜，味道感觉挺正宗，过油肉拌面好吃
Their signature spicy rice noodles with naan combo is absolutely amazing, paired with tender cumin lamb ribs and classic dapanji for a satisfying feast after class.
好地道的新疆味道！量真的大，价格也实惠！面随便免费加吃到饱！

When it comes to Chinese food, JIANGYU at 343 Anzac Parade Kingsford is a hidden gem. Ignore the poor reviews and trust in the culinary delights.
7pm on a Tuesday night, the place was packed (a good sign)

From exotic offal to classic dishes, the menu offers something for every palate.

We played it safe....

We ordered:
Lamb chops with chilli sauce.   A better description, Lamb off cuts (not chops) 20% very fatty/ 80% full of meat. Regardless, the dish was very tasty and enough for 3 people

Spicy Chicken “hot pot” with chilli. Lots of raw garlic cloves “YUM” flavours are still rolling in my mouth the next day. Very nice.

The Cauliflower dish and smashed cucumber complemented the other dishes.

The ambience and hygiene might not score top marks, but the food is a stellar 4 out of 5 stars

$75.00 for 3 people (4 generous dishes + rice)
